## Release Gate

- [ ] Scope matches one GitHub issue or one explicitly approved issue bundle
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are still accurate
- [ ] Relevant tests are green
- [ ] Sacrificial validation was run when behavior changed materially
- [ ] Real user-surface validation was completed
- [ ] Demo/runtime health is green if user-facing behavior changed
- [ ] Remaining risks are documented
